profile.headline: Chief Systems Architect at BrainTrust Holdings LLC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed a distributed cyber-security system, which would assess current threats on a customer’s network and provide a threat evaluation in the form of a score.

The system was written on a Linux platform using Java for all back-end server processing and Postgresql for the DBMS. 

The web application was an MVC solution that used a combination of Node.js and Sails for the web server, Angular.js for the front-end Javascript framework and SASS for styling.

The interface between the web application and the java server was a RESTful api.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed Command and Control application for FAA Verification and Validation System of Systems Assessment Platform utilizing Java.

The web development team lead on the System of Systems Assessment Platform for the FAA. Full-stack, full life-cycle LAMP development using Dojo, JQuery, Sencha Touch and Sencha ExtJS for our JavaScript front-end; Java, PHP, Python and Node.js for our back-end; Apache and Tomcat for our web servers; as well as SQL Server, MySQL and PostgresSql for our DBMS.

Designed and developed on both the front-end and back-end of the System of Systems Assessment Platform for the FAA Technical Center. This platform is an agent-based system, which simulated the entire National Airspace, including all actors, such as pilots and air traffic controllers. My primary responsibilities included web application development using javascript, php, and java; development of interfaces for third-party applications using NodeJs, and development of an air maneuver network through the use of a graph database (Neo4J).

Used javascript, php, python and java to design and develop a Real-time incident tracking system, which utilized sms and gps to track the whereabouts of employees and equipment in remote and/or dangerous locations.

Used javascript, php, python and java to design and develop an explosive device notification tool, which allowed members of various bomb squads to coordinate efforts and provide status updates to any member of the team that was registered for the updates.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led a team responsible for the integration of a Command and Control Planning System into an Army Maneuver and Control System of Record.

Developed a .NET client application in C# that was responsible for relaying data from a Publish and Subscribe JBOSS Web Service to a Command and Control Planning System using MSMQ technology and asynchronous messaging.

Developed a C# windows service that was used as a many to one communication interface to the Army’s Data Dissemination Server. This service accepted and monitored multiple client connections

Developed a fully functional Map Tool, which acted as a user interface for a windows service that provided terrain reasoning.  The Map Tool provided users with the ability to query the service for unit locations, graphical control measures, tactical spatial objects and route solving.  The Map Tool would then asynchronously process the messages and display the results to the user.

Developed a windows service, using ActiveMQ for messaging that provided terrain reasoning to a DARPA client application used for simulation war gaming.

Developed client relations, provided end user training and innovative technical solutions, conducted software demonstrations, and increased efficiency to enhance profitability.

Worked on a decision and support system, which received live feeds from a simulation interface and a sensor modeling system.

Developed a user interface, which allowed soldiers to identify targets based on images provided by simulated robotic sensors.

Developed a user interface, which allowed soldiers to make battle damage assessments based on simulated robotic sensors. 

Provided software support for DARPA experiments located in Orlando, Fl.

Enhanced software to reduce operating time or improve efficiencies.

Provided technical direction to programmers to ensure program deadlines were met.

Developed image controls using ActiveX controls such as MapControl 8.0 and LEAD Toolkit.
